questions.stem: Using the cuboid from the previous question (base $6\text{ cm} \times 8\text{ cm}$, height $5\text{ cm}$), what angle does the space diagonal make with the base? Round to 1 decimal place.
questions.explanation: The base diagonal is $10\text{ cm}$ and the height is $5\text{ cm}$. $\tan\theta = \frac{5}{10} = 0.5$, so $\theta = \tan^{-1}(0.5) \approx 26.6°$.
